distribution_definition.median: arithmetic mean of the two central ordered samples for even n
distribution_definition.p05_p95: type-7 linear quantiles at probabilities 0.05 and 0.95
distribution_definition.mad: median absolute deviation from the derived median
distribution_definition.cv: sample standard deviation divided by arithmetic mean

dispatch_40_atoms.reason: Open topology already favors sparse at N=32, while compact topology still favors dense at N=48 for every measured batch. A topology-agnostic atom-only threshold cannot improve both distributions, and no N=40 neighborhood was run.

reuse_distribution.warning: Several open/sparse reuse cells are multimodal or contain periodic spikes; min/median/max alone is not a sufficient archive.

limitations: No N=40 or dense neighborhood at N=36/44 was measured, so the exact crossover cannot be refit.
